The business messages the run touches are in section 14 and are asserted by ID and by their substituted values. The harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and treatment keys, the stub answer shapes, the evidence format and retention and the pass or fail gate are fixed at the wave entry check. The vulnerable-customer contact-limit values are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0466); they are held as P3 parameter data read from the fixture, and the harness fails the run if a limit is written in code.

edits.old: The harness asserts these rules and changes none of them; the rules themselves are evaluated in RWB-S8-E7002-APP and the states are held by P3 rwb-case.
edits.new:
The harness asserts these rules and changes none of them; the rules themselves are evaluated in RWB-S8-E7002-APP and the states are held by P3 rwb-case. Reference data is read as parameters under the reference-data contract DP-06 and DP-07: the vulnerable-customer contact-limit set and the deviation service level of 10 working days are read from those parameters, never from code, and the lists the harness reads are the DP04 records and the treatment read of AC2.

Coverage of the rules: BR1 by AC2 and AC3; BR2 by AC2 and AC3; BR3 by AC1 and AC4; BR4 by AC2; BR5 and BR6 by AC4 and TC-E7-002-02-ITG; BR7 by AC8; BR8 by AC1 for X2 only, the other X flows being built in RWB-S8-E7002-APP; BR9 by AC9; BR10 by AC2; BR11 by AC5.
